candidates.statement: 1. This Law shall regulate the relations pertaining to the circulation of medicines, medicinal substances, herbal raw materials and investigational pharmaceutical products in order to provide the population with safe, efficacious, high-quality, affordable medicines and reliable information thereon, as well as shall prescribe the sector-specific powers of competent state bodies of the Republic of Armenia and entities engaged in circulation of medicines.
